title: Senior Software Developer - React Native
description:
Project Description:

Our Client is one of largest TV providers in North America and we are searching for a Senior Software Developer to join our team. The project focuses on developing mobile application for video streaming platform.


Responsibilities:

You will be implementing new features and enhancing existing functionalities on client applications to support streaming video products. This includes estimation, design, development, testing, and documentation.

Collaborate with other software engineers, product managers, and architects in a cross functional environment to ensure functions and performance meet customer requirements in a cost effective and maintainable way.

Provide on-call support including monitoring, triaging and resolving production issues


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • - Proficient in JavaScript and React Native mobile app development (5+ years) as well as at least one of the following: Java/Kotlin or Obj-C/Swift
  • - Streaming mobile app development experience with iOS/Android and TV Platforms
  • - Strong teamwork focus and the ability to foster collaboration within and across teams
  • - Experience with agile development
  • - Good verbal/written communications skills


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator
description:
Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator


LegalSight is an exciting legal services firm at the crossroads of global innovation. Our company provides intellectual property-related legal technology and services for clients around the world. Our team specializes in products, software, and services to assist with patent and trademark application processes, including filing, renewals, and translations.


The Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator will work within our international legal translations division. This is an administrative, non-technical position focused on document review and proofreading.


The Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator will conduct quality assessments on translated legal documents. Key responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborate with the Project Management team to clarify project parameters.
  • Performing quality checks on translations.
  • Communicate effectively with vendors world-wide in order to reconcile errors in the translated text.
  • Implement process improvements using available technology solutions.


A successful Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator must have:

  • Experience in reviewing and proofreading translated documents, particularly legal documents.
  • Experience with CAT tools is highly preferred.
  • A high degree of proficiency in relevant computer skills (Microsoft Office).
  • Experience with Adobe Acrobat or similar tools.
  • A highly focused, detail-oriented, and client-centric mindset.
  • Ability to set and meet multiple deadlines.
  • Ability to manage time effectively.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Proven problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work well in both independent and highly collaborative settings.
  • Ability to excel in fast-paced work environment.

title: Senior CISCO Engineer – Cisco Voice (CUCM, SIP)
description:
We are seeking a Senior Unified Communications Engineer with deep expertise in enterprise voice and telephony , who can lead and support the transition from Cisco on-premises UC environments to Microsoft Teams Phone and modern CCaaS platforms .


This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on design, migration, and Tier 3 support , working in a global enterprise environment across EMEA, US, and APAC.



Required


  • 7+ years of experience in Unified Communications / Enterprise Voice .

Strong hands-on experience with:

  • Microsoft Teams Phone
  • Cisco Voice (CUCM, SIP)
  • Solid understanding of telephony fundamentals and SIP-based architectures .
  • Experience supporting or implementing cloud-based telephony solutions .
  • Fluent English (spoken and written) – mandatory.


Nice to Have


  • Experience with Oracle SBC , Avaya, or similar platforms.
  • Exposure to Contact Center solutions (Cisco UCCE, Five9, NICE CXone).
  • Experience working in large enterprise or global environments .


What You’ll Do


Microsoft Teams Phone & Cloud Telephony

  • Design, implement, and support Microsoft Teams Phone solutions.
  • Lead and support Direct Routing, Operator Connect, and Calling Plans .
  • Integrate Teams Phone with SBCs and telecom providers .


Enterprise Voice & Cisco UC


  • Support and maintain Cisco on-premises voice infrastructure , including:
  • Cisco Call Manager (CUCM)
  • SIP Trunking
  • Provide Tier 3 / engineering-level support for complex voice issues.


Contact Center & CCaaS


  • Support migrations of Contact Center platforms:
  • From Cisco UCCE / Five9
  • To NICE CXone CCaaS
  • Ensure stable SIP connectivity between telephony and CCaaS platforms.


Migration & Global Rollouts


  • Execute telephony migration plans with minimal service disruption.
  • Support global go-live events and post-migration stabilization.
  • Collaborate with regional engineering teams and vendors worldwide.



¡Join Us!


  • Work on enterprise-scale UC and telephony transformations .
  • Gain deep exposure to Teams Phone and CCaaS modernization .
  • Collaborate with global teams and leading technology partners.
  • Play a key role in high-visibility, business-critical projects



We offer:


  • GROSS Salary in BRL under CLT Job offer - Full time Job + Benefits + 100% Remote.



Don't hesitate and share your updated resume in English with us so we can review it and have the pleasure to discuss it in more detail. .

title: Especialista de Produto (Suporte e Atendimento)
description:
Venha fazer parte de uma empresa líder em tecnologia educacional!


Local: Remoto

Modelo: CLT


Especialista de Produto na ClipEscola


Você é apaixonado por Customer Success, tecnologia e inovação? Então essa pode ser a oportunidade perfeita para você fazer parte de um time que transforma a comunicação escolar por meio da tecnologia!


Na ClipEscola, você será uma das principais referências sobre a plataforma e regras de negócio, utilizando esse conhecimento para garantir o sucesso dos nossos clientes em cada etapa da jornada.


Suas principais responsabilidades:

  • Resolver dúvidas e solicitações de forma rápida, empática e eficiente através de chats e tickets.
  • Trabalhar com metas de excelência, como o CSAT.
  • Participar de projetos com outras equipes para melhorar a experiência dos nossos clientes.


Procuramos alguém que tenha:

  • Formação completa ou em andamento (Sistemas, Comunicação, Pedagogia, Marketing ou áreas afins).
  • Excelente capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Habilidade de organização, gestão do tempo e definição de prioridades.
  • Escuta ativa e empatia para entender com profundidade as dores e objetivos dos clientes.
  • Comunicação verbal e escrita clara, assertiva e acolhedora.
  • Experiência em Suporte, Implantação ou CS em empresas SaaS (de preferência EdTech).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de atendimento, como Movidesk, Freshdesk ou similares.


Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Trabalho remoto (com opção de híbrido em Floripa)
  • Cartão Benefícios Flash
  • TotalPass, Clude Saúde e C4Life
  • Plano de Saúde e Odonto sem carência e sem coparticipação (para colaborador e dependentes até 18 anos)
  • Aulas de inglês online
  • Folga no aniversário


Para quem opta pelo híbrido:

  • Vale transporte/combustível (para dias presenciais - opcional)
  • Bebidas e snacks à vontade
  • Auxílio mudança caso queira morar em Floripa! ️


Nosso espaço:

Nossa sede está no Corporate Park , um ambiente inspirador com jardins, lagos, cafés e restaurantes. O escritório é amplo, iluminado, sem dress code, pet friendly e com áreas de descanso, puffs, snacks, cozinha equipada e aquele cafezinho esperto. Tudo para você se sentir bem todos os dias!


Venha transformar a comunicação escolar com a gente!

title: Analista de negócios sênior
description:
Estamos procurando um profissional com capacidade de realizar a análise de negócios, na área de Recursos Nauturais, orientando a equipe no desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Formação:

  • Superior completo em Ciências Exatas, da Terra e afins.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento do sistema ArcGIS;
  • Conhecimento de SIG;
  • Conhecimento em TI/infraestrutura;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Conceito de Sensoriamento Remoto
  • Conhecimento na área de Recursos Naturais (preferencialmente mineração e/ou meio ambiente);
  • Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes;
  • Conhecimento de DevOps;
  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;
  • Inglês Avançado.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Interpretar documentação e informações de negócio compreendendo processos de negócio mapeados e contribuindo para a definição da arquitetura e implementação da solução e ao atendimento das necessidades de negócio existentes.
  • Criar documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos garantindo o registro do processo e práticas utilizadas.
  • Conduzir processos de Discovery
  • Realizar o levantamento dos requisitos da aplicação
  • Orientar a análise, modelagem e documentação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Disseminar o entendimento sobre os processos de negócio necessários à implementação da solução, assimilando e orientando o uso de conceitos e vocabulário próprio das áreas de negócio envolvidas no projeto.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.
  • Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes de alta complexidade.
  • Avaliar e selecionar as opções da plataforma ESRI que melhor atendam uma respectiva solução.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?


Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Social Seller
description:
Descrição da vaga: SDR / Social Seller Pleno ou Sênior – Jurassic Marketing


Contrato: PJ

Remuneração: R$ 2.500 fixo + comissão variável atrativa (% sobre vendas + bônus por reuniões qualificadas )

Local: Remoto

Sobre a Jurassic Marketing

A Jurassic Marketing é uma agência de Growth Marketing com atuação no Brasil e no exterior. Nosso core é eventos e festivais , ajudando produtores a venderem mais ingressos com estratégia, tráfego pago, funis de vendas, CRM e inteligência de dados .

Também aplicamos a mesma lógica de crescimento em outros segmentos, com um diferencial forte: automação e IA aplicada ao comercial , especialmente no WhatsApp.


O Desafio

Você será responsável por gerar e qualificar oportunidades reais para o time de vendas.

No dia a dia, isso significa:

  • Qualificar leads inbound que chegam via WhatsApp e Instagram, conduzindo pré-calls estratégicas ;
  • Atuar como Social Seller , abordando potenciais clientes de forma inteligente (Instagram, WhatsApp, LinkedIn e base de interações);
  • Acompanhar as conversas do nosso SDR IA com os leads , entrar no timing certo e conduzir o lead para o próximo passo;
  • Garantir que o lead chegue preparado e bem qualificado para as reuniões com nossos closers.

Seu objetivo é simples: encher o pipeline com qualidade e manter o funil andando com consistência.

Importante: boa parte da comunicação e condução do funil acontece via WhatsApp (contato e follow-up) e Google Meet (pré-calls e alinhamentos).


Responsabilidades
  • Realizar pré-calls de qualificação com leads inbound via Ligação no Whatsapp ou (diagnóstico + fit + próximos passos).
  • Acompanhar e acelerar leads atendidos pela nossa IA no WhatsApp , assumindo quando necessário.
  • Abordar potenciais clientes via WhatsApp, LinkedIn e Instagram (social selling + prospecção).
  • Identificar dores, necessidades, momento do negócio e potencial de investimento dos leads.
  • Agendar reuniões qualificadas (SQLs ) com o time comercial.
  • Manter o CRM atualizado (histórico, notas, status e próximos passos).
  • Participar de reuniões rápidas de alinhamento com o time comercial.
  • Elaborar relatórios simples de atividades e resultados (cadência, taxa de resposta, pré-calls, SQLs, motivos de perda).


Requisitos
  • Experiência prévia em SDR/BDR, prospecção comercial ou vendas internas .
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita (objetividade, clareza e persuasão).
  • Organização e disciplina com follow-up e rotina de pipeline.
  • Conhecimento prático de social selling (WhatsApp, Instagram, LinkedIn).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e foco em resultados (volume + qualidade).
  • Perfil comprometido, proativo e consistente


Diferenciais
  • Entender o mercado de eventos/festivais (lotes, sazonalidade, urgência, dores, problemas e dinâmica de produtores de eventos).
  • Experiência com marketing digital/performance (funil, lead, CPA, ROAS, etc.).
  • Vivência com CRM e automação comercial (GoHighLevel).
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado .


O que oferecemos
  • R$ 2.500 fixo + comissão variável atrativa (% sobre vendas + bônus por metas de reuniões qualificadas).
  • Remoto + flexibilidade com responsabilidade.
  • Folga no dia do aniversário
  • Possibilidade de ir a eventos de clientes (vivenciar o mercado e fazer networking).
  • Cursos online e materiais de capacitação disponibilizados pela empresa.
  • Ambiente que respira crescimento : metas claras, feedback rápido, cultura de performance e evolução constante.
  • Ferramentas estratégicas (CRM, IA, cadências e playbooks).
  • Possibilidade real de crescimento em uma agência com atuação internacional.


Como se candidatar

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Automation & Operations Specialist
description:
Job Title: Automation & Operations Specialist


Schedule : Full-time (40 hours/week); requires EST or PST working-hour overlap.


Location : Fully remote (LATAM-based candidates welcome).


About This Role:

Our client is a growing automation-focused company that builds custom operational workflows and systems. They work at the intersection of automation, no-code platforms, and AI-driven workflows to solve complex operational problems where no off-the-shelf solution exists.

We are looking for a hands-on Automation & Operations Manager to own the execution of day-to-day operational workflows. This is not a traditional project management role; it is an execution-focused position for a specialist who can build, maintain, and improve systems. You will work directly with the CEO to ensure system reliability and scalability.


Responsibilities:

  • Workflow Architecture: Build, maintain, and optimize automation workflows using Make.com and/or n8n, ensuring consistent execution across CRM processes and reporting.
  • System Integration: Design and implement custom solutions, managing API-based integrations and webhooks between various tools and platforms.
  • Troubleshooting & Reliability: Take ownership of existing automation libraries; diagnose failures, debug errors, and resolve issues efficiently to maintain high performance.
  • AI Implementation: Leverage AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, AI coding assistants) to accelerate workflow development and solve ambiguous technical problems.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Document workflows, maintain clear SOPs, and provide the CEO with regular updates on status, risks, and blockers.


Requirements:

  • 4–6 years of experience in automation, operations, or workflow-heavy roles.
  • Hands-on experience building complex workflows with Make.com and/or n8n .
  • Strong technical understanding of APIs, webhooks, and system integrations.
  • Proficiency with database tools like Airtable.
  • Ability to work independently to solve ambiguous technical problems without immediate supervision.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with JSON and basic scripting (JavaScript, Python).
  • Experience integrating AI into automation workflows.
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., GoHighLevel) and lightweight app builders (e.g., Replit).


Payment: Long-term engagement (USD or local currency).

title: Senior NodeJS Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.


With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 5 years working with NodeJS;
  • Fluency in English (mandatory ).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Tech Lead - ML Engineer Sênior/ Azure
description:
Você será responsável por:

Definição e Implementação

  • Arquitetura completa do MVP
  • Estratégia de escalabilidade e otimização de custos

Atuação Técnica em ML

  • Escolha de arquiteturas de modelo
  • Estratégias de performance (latência e throughput)
  • Validação técnica dos resultados

Apoio Direto ao Time

  • Ajustes finos nos modelos
  • Decisões de pré-processamento de imagem

Garantindo

  • SLA de latência ≤ 10s
  • Acurácia mínima definida
  • Observabilidade e confiabilidade do sistema


Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Experiencia com Azure
  • Machine Learning em produção
  • liderando tecnicamente projetos


Stack Obrigatória


Azure (nível arquiteto) — obrigatório

  • Azure Machine Learning
  • Azure Functions (intermediário)
  • Azure Service Bus (intermediário)
  • Azure Blob Storage (intermediário)
  • Azure Monitor / Application Insights (intermediário)


Linguagens & Frameworks


  • Python avançado
  • Visão Computacional
  • OpenCV avançado (obrigatório)
  • YOLO v8+ (uso prático obrigatório)


Infraestrutura


  • Terraform (definição e revisão de infraestrutura)
  • Arquitetura serverless e assíncrona


Experiência Obrigatória em

  • Melhoria de imagem:
  • Normalização
  • Correção de iluminação
  • Redução de ruído
  • Cenários noturnos / chuva
  • Inferência em produção
  • Avaliação de trade-off custo x performance


Diferenciais Desejáveis


  • Projetos com:
  • Tráfego
  • OCR veicular
  • Pedágio
  • Visão computacional outdoor
  • Certificações:
  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Azure AI Engineer.


Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;

title: Network Customer Success Engineer
description:
This is a remote position to work from LATAM collaborating with US clients.


We offer:

  • 100% Remote Work
  • $21 USD per hour


Title: Customer Success Engineer

As a Customer Success Engineer within the LATAM SASE team, you will be part of a business-critical capability to enable our customers’ secure environments across the LATAM region. You act as their day-to-day technical contact, building relationships with them to ensure proper security integrations. This includes guidance for adoption, accelerated integrations with new cloud security products, and real-time support and strategy.


Responsibilities :

  • Assist customers in implementing SASE solutions and fully integrate these into their security and networking operations
  • Be the first line of defense in proactively addressing customer needs for technical assistance, and coordinating and prioritizing timely resolutions with engineering teams
  • Serve as a customer advocate in influencing product roadmap and improvements
  • Coach customers on how to establish and manage their Cloud Security Change Management / Governance / Center of Excellence program
  • Identify risks to the customer achieving their stated business goals and work with the account team to build a risk mitigation plan or escalate as needed
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of typical business challenges faced by customers and common objectives to appropriately map features and associated business benefits to address their needs
  • Be a Go-To customer expert on *** SASE security solutions and become a Subject Matter expert over time


Required Qualifications:

  • In-depth understanding of networking and security concepts and experience with multi-vendor networking devices such as routers, switches, firewalls, traffic generators, etc.
  • Understanding SASE architecture and value proposition
  • Enterprise-level designing/troubleshooting experience in Routing Protocols (BGP / OSPF / EIGRP)
  • Expertise with Remote Access VPN solutions, IPSEC, PKI & SSL, TCP/IP, Authentication Protocols (SAML, SSO, LDAP, RADIUS, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Linux (including BASH and Python scripting)

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a Senior Product Designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack
description:
Procuramos uma pessoa que esteja sempre conectada com as novas tendências e consiga transpor o melhor de nossa cultura para os produtos produzidos e consequentemente para nosso cliente final. O comprometimento, a criatividade, a autogestão e a vontade de se aprimorar são as principais qualidades que estamos buscando. Você se tornará membro de um time altamente qualificado, autônomo e multifuncional, com uma forte ênfase na qualidade do produto e do código.


Sobre a Almaden:


Almaden AI é uma empresa inovadora que trabalha na convergência entre a Experiência Digital do Funcionário (DEX) e a Inteligência Artificial Generativa, com foco na transformação e no aumento do impacto da tecnologia no mercado global. Estamos crescendo rapidamente e procuramos pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, inovação e negócios, prontas para fazer parte dessa jornada transformadora.


Descrição das atividades:


O que você vai fazer:


· Desenvolver recursos novos;

· Integrar as APIs externas e internas para a nossa plataforma;

· Ajudar na arquitetura, concepção, implementação e manutenção de projetos;

· Trabalhar em método ágil scrum, colaborando com seus companheiros de equipe

· Estimar junto com o time a complexidade das tarefas;

· Usar ferramentas para testar APIs e desempenho (Postman, Selenium, JMeter, Lighthouse);

· Buscar novas ferramentas e técnicas para a melhoria contínua de nossos sistemas.

 O que esperamos:

· Escrever código robusto, de qualidade e fácil de manter;

· Aplicar boas práticas de desenvolvimento e seguir padrões do time, sempre buscando oportunidades de melhoria e inovação;

· Criar APIs com arquitetura em microserviços;

· Auxiliar o restante da equipe durante a resolução de problemas;

· Manter os produtos atualizados e utilizando as últimas tendências do mercado;

· Sugerir soluções criativas que otimizem o trabalho;


Experiência:


· Desenvolvimento utilizando NodeJS, ReactJS, JavaScript (ES6) e TypeScript;

· Banco de dados (SQL e NoSQL), idealmente o PostgreSQL;

· Domínio do Protocolo HTTP e seus métodos;

· Implementação e consumo de REST/API;

· Design de APIs REST;

· Arquitetura de microserviços, containers;

· GIT;


Requisitos:


· Trabalhar muito bem em equipe e em home office;

· Evidênciar boas habilidades de comunicação e colaboração;

· Manter-se atualizado na tecnologia e que aproveita de oportunidades para inovar;

· Mostrar experiência trabalhando numa metodologia ágil;

· Gostar de desafios e de se divertir;

· Ter coragem para tentar coisas novas;

· Apreciar o valor de entregar código bem testado;


Desejável conhecimento :


· C #;

· Python;

· GraphQL;

· Java;

· C;

· C ++;

· NextJS;

· BitBucket ou similar;

· Azure DevOps;

· Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment;

· Arquitetura e configuração de aplicações em Cloud;

· Consumo de Web Services SOAP;


Diferencial:


· Docker

· Kubernetes

· Familiaridade das APIs do AWS, Google Cloud ou Azure

· Inglês

  • Plano de carreira e crescimento exponencial.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.

title: Sample Manager LIMS
description:
Technical Lead – Sample Manager LIMS

Brazil (Remote); preferred in Sao Paulo.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead – SampleManager to lead and deliver SampleManager

LIMS implementation and enhancement projects. This role is responsible for driving technical execution,

collaborating closely with clients and internal teams, and ensuring high-quality, compliant, and timely

delivery of solutions aligned with company standards and SOPs.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the technical team on SampleManager LIMS implementation and enhancement projects.

• Act as a technical front-facing resource with customers to understand enhancement

requirements and propose effective solutions.

• Facilitate requirement-gathering workshops and produce clear, detailed requirement

specification documents.

• Design, develop, configure, and implement enhancements and revisions to meet client needs.

• Deliver solutions according to agreed timelines, ensuring compliance with company standards,

SOPs, and quality guidelines.

• Provide technical guidance and support to internal team members and clients throughout the

project lifecycle.

• Evaluate client requirements and translate them into scalable, high-quality technical solutions.

• Contribute to the delivery of high-quality software through effective system design, peer code

reviews, unit testing, and best development practices.

• Participate across the full system lifecycle, including design, development, testing,

implementation, maintenance, and ongoing support.

• Collaborate effectively with multiple internal teams and multiple client stakeholders

simultaneously.

Technical Scope

• Develop and configure SampleManager workflows, including:

✓ Sample workflows

✓ Stock and instrument modules

✓ Instrument interfacing using Integration Manager

✓ Report Designer, Forms Designer, and Label Designer

✓ Sample Scheduler, Batch Management, Lot Management, and Plate Handling

✓ Stability, SQC, SM-IDI, PIMS, and Dashboards

Required Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in SampleManager implementation and support.

• Extensive hands-on experience developing and configuring solutions in SampleManager LIMS

• Strong background in systems analysis, design, development, quality assurance, and integration

methodologies.

• Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously with strong analytical and

problem-solving skills.

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a team, with minimal supervision in project

environments.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to balance and prioritize multiple concurrent projects.

• Excellent communication skills; English language proficiency is required. Spanish is nice to have

• Flexible, self-motivated, and proactive team player with a positive, delivery-focused attitude.

• Willingness and ability to learn and migrate to new technologies while adhering to priorities and

timelines.

• Clear understanding of individual and company goals, with a strong commitment to seeing work

through to completion.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (TypeScript)
description:
Radity is a global software engineering company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients around the world. Were passionate about building great technology and fostering a collaborative environment where people grow, take ownership, and make a real impact.


Were currently looking for a TypeScript Fullstack Engineer to join our remote-first development team. If you're someone who thrives in a fast-paced tech environment and enjoys working with modern tools like NestJS, Node.js, Next.js, and cloud services this is your chance to build great software with a passionate team.


Your Role

As a Fullstack Engineer at Radity, you'll work on complex and impactful applications using TypeScript across the stack. Were especially interested in candidates with strong backend skills in Node.js and NestJS.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain scalable full-stack web applications using TypeScript and Node.js and NestJS.
  • Build and maintain backend services using Fastify and modern API design principles.
  • Develop responsive and performant frontend applications using React, TanStack (Query/Table/Router), and Mantine.
  • Design, implement, and maintain data models and database interactions using Prisma ORM.
  • Integrate with internal and external REST APIs and third-party services.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers in a distributed, cross-functional team.
  • Ensure code quality through code reviews, testing, and best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the full stack in both development and production environments.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) B2+ level or higher.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and backend development with Node.js and NestJS.
  • Hands-on experience with Fastify or similar Node.js frameworks (Express, NestJS, etc.)
  • Solid experience with React and modern frontend tooling, including TanStack libraries.
  • Experience with Prisma ORM and relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred).
  • Good understanding of RESTful APIs, backend architecture, and data modeling.
  • A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and appreciation for clean, maintainable code.


What's In It for You

  • A remote-first role where you can work from anywhere.
  • Hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies and real-world challenges.
  • Supportive teammates who value quality, learning, and growth.
  • Opportunities to shape architecture and technical direction.
  • Flexible hours and a collaborative, open culture.
  • Support for certifications, learning resources, or professional development.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
The Role  


As a BDR at Upstart AEC, you’ll sit at the front of our revenue engine. You’ll work across enterprise-level outreach and transactional sales, combining high-volume execution with thoughtful strategy. 


This is not a script-only role. We’re looking for someone who can think, adapt, and communicate exceptionally well. 


What You’ll Do  


  • Conduct cold calling and outbound outreach  to prospective clients 
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads and move opportunities forward 
  • Support enterprise-level sales conversations while also handling transactional deals 
  • Speak confidently and professionally with US-based stakeholders 
  • Help build and refine outreach strategies, messaging, and sales processes 
  • Maintain accurate CRM records and follow-up discipline 
  • Collaborate closely with leadership and operations teams 
  • Represent Upstart AEC with trust, credibility, and consistency 


Who We’re Looking For  


This role is for a Type A, high-energy, high-integrity individual with strong communication skills and international exposure. 


Must-haves:  


  • Considerable experience in the United States  (cultural fluency is critical) 
  • Currently living in or open to working from Latin America  
  • Strong international experience and cross-cultural communication skills 
  • Excellent spoken English with a confident, natural phone presence 
  • Comfortable with cold calling and real-time conversations 
  • Trustworthy, reliable, and accountable 
  • Highly motivated, proactive, and eager to grow 


Nice-to-haves:  


  • Previous experience as a BDR, SDR, or in sales-related roles 
  • Exposure to enterprise sales environments 
  • Experience working with US companies or clients 
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.) 


What Success Looks Like  


  • Consistent, high-quality outreach and follow-up 
  • Strong lead qualification and handoff to next sales stages 
  • Clear, professional communication on calls and emails 
  • Ability to move conversations forward, not just “check boxes” 
  • Growing confidence, ownership, and deal impact over time 


Why This Role Is Special  


  • Real exposure to enterprise and US-market sales  
  • High visibility and direct collaboration with leadership 
  • Room to grow quickly based on performance 
  • Fully remote, international environment 
  • A company that values trust, autonomy, and sharp thinking

title: Sr. Desenvolvedor Back-end Java
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

O projeto envolve a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento de uma plataforma robusta, sustentada por uma infraestrutura moderna baseada em APIs. Faremos a integração com um parceiro fintech líder de mercado para lidar com a mecânica central de abertura de contas, financiamento e negociações (trading), permitindo que nossa equipe se concentre em construir uma experiência superior voltada ao cliente.

O sucesso exige mais do que apenas um código excelente. Você se juntará a uma equipe dinâmica e multidisciplinar de gerentes de produto, designers de UX/UI, estrategistas de negócios e especialistas em conformidade (compliance). Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração para navegar por regulamentações financeiras complexas, traduzir requisitos de negócios intrincados em soluções técnicas elegantes e resolver problemas desafiadores de integração com nossos parceiros externos. Esta função é ideal para um solucionador de problemas proativo, que prospera em um ambiente colaborativo e é apaixonado por construir produtos que tenham um impacto real no futuro financeiro das pessoas.


Requisitos

  • Inglês B2 ou superior.
  • Forte proficiência em Java, com foco em frameworks modernos — especialmente Spring Boot.
  • Conhecimento avançado em bancos de dados relacionais (ex: Oracle, PostgreSQL) e bancos de dados NoSQL (ex: CosmosDB, DynamoDB).
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços, incluindo padrões de comunicação como REST e gRPC.
  • Expertise em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (event-driven), utilizando ferramentas como RabbitMQ, Kafka e Amazon SQS.
  • Experiência na implantação de aplicações em ambientes de Nuvem (AWS ou Azure).
  • Proficiência em containers e orquestração, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Implementação e automação de pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou ArgoCD.
  • Uso avançado de Git e estratégias colaborativas de ramificação (branching) (Gitflow, práticas de code review).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging, tais como Prometheus, Grafana e ELK Stack.
  • Implementação de estratégias de testes robustas (unitário, integração, ponta a ponta/E2E) utilizando JUnit, Mockito e Testcontainers.
  • Adoção de boas práticas em TDD/BDD e análise de cobertura de código.
  • Experiência de trabalho em equipes Ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência prática com sistemas de alto volume e alta escalabilidade.
  • Capacidade comprovada de contribuir para refatoração de código, otimização de desempenho e melhorias arquiteturais contínuas.
  • Compreensão de conceitos de sistemas distribuídos e sua aplicação prática.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de serviços complementares em Node.js.
  • Experiência com plataformas de investimento.
  • Experiência em ambiente financeiro.
  • Certificações em Nuvem (Cloud).


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida.


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Picpay benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Picpay benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco;
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: Líder Técnico II (Web/Mobile/Servidores)
description:
O Inatel está recrutando profissionais para atuação na liderança técnica de projetos de software no Inatel Competence Center - PDI SW.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Liderar tecnicamente times e projetos de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Propor soluções que atendam ao negócio e sejam escaláveis, possuem protocolos de comunicação, regras de negócios e integração com equipamentos;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica do projeto, operacionais e de apoio à gerência;
  • Definir e documentar arquitetura lógica e executável de sistemas;
  • Realizar a especificação funcional de projetos;
  • Prover suporte ao time de QA;
  • Revisar código desenvolvido conforme boas práticas da tecnologia;
  • Projetar software para integração e entrega contínua;
  • Prover capacitação, orientação e suporte técnico aos desenvolvedores.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo na área de tecnologia, preferencialmente em cursos de Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Experiências em:

  • Desenvolvimento de soluções NodeJS ou .NET Core,
  • Angular e/ou React,
  • APIs Rest,
  • Arquitetura de soluções em cloud,
  • Arquitetura de microserviços,
  • Banco de dados não relacional/relacional,
  • Cultura DevOps,
  • Uso de ferramentas de design UX/UI,
  • Metodologias de desenvolvimento ágeis.


Domínio em:

  • Modelagem de projetos,
  • Ferramentas de análise de código e de controle de versionamento de código.


Conhecimento em:

  • Design patterns,
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicativo móvel,
  • Testes automatizados.


Seria interessante se você tivesse:


  • Capacidade de organização com múltiplas atividades e requisições simultâneas;
  • Capacidade de aprendizado e disseminação de conhecimento;
  • Inglês intermediário.

Informações adicionais

Horário de Trabalho: Segunda à sexta, das 08h às 12h e das 13h30 às 17h30.


Local de Trabalho: As atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho \"Home Office\".

title: Advogado(a) tributarista
description:
O LRI Advogados atende a mais de 20 anos, empresas multinacionais com soluções jurídicas personalizadas e eficientes. Buscamos ser reconhecidos por um trabalho de qualidade, ético e transparente. Contamos com uma equipe multidisciplinar altamente qualificada, que busca constantemente a atualização e o aperfeiçoamento profissional.

Para ampliar nossa equipe, estamos selecionando um(a) advogado(a) tributarista com comprovada experiência. • Atuação em Contencioso Tributário Administrativo e Judicial, bem como em Consultoria Tributária, envolvendo tributos das esferas federal, estadual e municipal;

• Assessoria em operações de M&A, reorganizações societárias e planejamentos sucessórios;

• Elaboração de pareceres, e-mails técnicos e apresentações;

• Participação em reuniões com clientes e em discussões estratégicas;

• Interface com outras áreas do escritório para estruturação de soluções tributárias integradas.

Requisitos

• Graduação em Direito, com 5 a 8 anos de experiência profissional;

• OAB ativa;

• Inglês avançado;

• Pós-graduação em Direito Tributário ou áreas correlatas (desejável);

• Perfil analítico, visão de negócio, comunicação clara, autonomia, proatividade, organização e boa gestão de prazos.


O que oferecemos:

· Plano de carreira estruturado, em ambiente profissional

· Bolsa auxílio anual para cursos de atualização

· Anuidade da OAB/SP

· Plano de saúde

· Wellhub/Gympass

· Parcerias com clube de benefícios, incluindo escolas de idiomas, instituições de ensino, entre outros

title: Snowflake Developer
description:
Title: Snowflake developer

Location: Brazil / Remote

Duration : Longterm


Role Description

This is a Snowflake Developer role. The Snowflake Developer will be responsible for day-to-day tasks related to designing, developing, and maintaining Snowflake data warehouse solutions to meet business needs.

Qualifications

•Minimum of a B.S. in Computer Science, MIS or related degree and 4+ years of related experience.

•In depth knowledge of Snowflake, DBT, SQL, python, database designs and data Models,

•Experience with Dagster, Data Pipelines, Relational or Columnar databases, Sigma reporting or Power BI or Tableau, Agile methodologies Scrum or Kanban, CI/CD pipeline, Azure cloud

services

•ETL and data integration experience

•Experience with cloud platforms like AWS or Azure is a plus

Tasks and Responsibilities:

•Develop automated data pipelines and data stores in Snowflake. This includes designing, implementing, testing, debugging, and deploying.

•Build metadata driven solution that is reusable and highly configurable.

•Automate testing and deployment in Snowflake.

•Partner with business analysts to groom stories and implement those stories.

•Work on an agile team to quickly iterate and release solutions.

•Provide technical advice and assist end-users in solving problems.

•Continuously learn new skills and make improvement in the product.

title: React native developer
description:
Project Description:

Our Client is one of largest TV providers in North America and we are searching for a Senior Software Developer to join our team. The project focuses on developing mobile application for video streaming platform.


Responsibilities:

  • You will be implementing new features and enhancing existing functionalities on client applications to support streaming video products. This includes estimation, design, development, testing, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with other software engineers, product managers, and architects in a cross functional environment to ensure functions and performance meet customer requirements in a cost effective and maintainable way.
  • Provide on-call support including monitoring, triaging and resolving production issues


Mandatory Skills Description:

- Proficient in JavaScript and React Native mobile app development (5+ years) as well as at least one of the following: Java/Kotlin or Obj-C/Swift

- Streaming mobile app development experience with iOS/Android and TV Platforms

- Strong teamwork focus and the ability to foster collaboration within and across teams

- Experience with agile development

- Good verbal/written communications skills

-English: B2 Upper Intermediate

NOTE: On-calls support will be required, and will depend on the team structure and locations. Expect at least 2-3 hours overlap with the US based team in PST

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements

title: Executive Assistant (100% remote)
description:
MANDATORY to complete your application:


About the Role:


Are you an assertive, precise, and autonomous professional with strong organizational skills and a passion for providing high-level administrative support? We are looking for an Executive Assistant to assist with administrative tasks and provide general support to our executive team. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is highly organized, and can handle multiple tasks independently.


As an Executive Assistant, you will be responsible for supporting the day-to-day operations, managing communications, and anticipating the needs of our leadership team. Your ability to manage complex schedules, handle sensitive information, and communicate effectively in both Spanish and English will ensure smooth and efficient operations.


As an Executive Assistant, you will:

  • Assist with calendar management and schedule meetings for the executive team.
  • Respond to and manage emails promptly and professionally.
  • Handle messages and calls, ensuring clear communication.
  • Book travel arrangements including flights and hotel reservations, ensuring all logistics are in order.
  • Provide support with daily tasks such as making calls, organizing appointments, and conducting online research.
  • Anticipate needs and proactively propose solutions to improve efficiency.


Required Qualifications

  • Fluent in English and Spanish.
  • Proven experience as an Executive Assistant or in administrative support roles.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to handle competing priorities.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills, anticipating needs and offering solutions.
  • Ability to work independently while providing high-level support.
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment and managing confidential information.


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant supervision or struggle with independent decision-making.
  • You prefer a non-structured work environment without clear goals and processes.


APPLY NOW:


This is an external position to work at a WiseVAs client. Considering that the management of job positions is entirely handled by the hiring companies, and that WiseVAs operates solely as an intermediary between the candidate and the hiring company, the submission of proposals by candidates does not guarantee employment. Similarly, candidates acknowledge and authorize the storage of resumes and proposals in WiseVAs's database, as well as the receipt of messages, emails, and calls offering new job positions and opportunities.

title: AI Video Ad Creator +  Copywriter + Visual Asset Designer
description:
The opportunity


We’re building a high-output creative engine for paid ads-and we’re looking for a specialist who can write the words that sell and turn them into scroll-stopping short-form video ads using AI video tools, strong editing, and performance thinking.


This is not a “make pretty videos” role. This is concept → copy → creative → iterations → winners .

If you live at the intersection of genAI + storytelling + conversion copywriting , this role is for you.


You’ll create AI-driven video ads and visual assets for campaigns across TikTok, Instagram Reels/Stories, YouTube Shorts, Meta, and more. We optimize for ROAS, CTR, CVR, hook rate, hold rate, and retention -and the copywriting is a core lever in every asset we ship.


What you’ll do


You own the creative from message to motion-including the copywriting .

Copywriting + creative strategy

  • Write conversion-focused short-form scripts (15-45s) : hooks, problem framing, proof, offer, CTA.
  • Create multiple copy angles per concept (pain-based, benefit-based, curiosity, contrarian, founder POV, social proof, demo-driven).
  • Write and version hook lines, VO scripts, on-screen text, captions, headlines, end-card CTAs , and thumbnail copy.
  • Translate product benefits into clear, punchy, platform-native messaging (no fluff, no generic AI-sounding copy).
  • Apply direct-response frameworks (Problem → Agitation → Solution, Before/After, Myth-busting, Objection handling, etc.) with modern pacing.

Video production + asset creation

  • Produce short-form ad creatives designed for conversion (tight cuts, retention-first pacing, pattern interrupts).
  • Create AI-generated video sequences and combine them with real footage/UGC where needed.
  • Generate visual assets for ad variations: thumbnails, product scenes, backgrounds, overlays, cutdowns, motion graphics, end cards.
  • Build multiple versions of the same concept (different hooks, copy angles, pacing, captions, VO, formats).
  • Work from a brief and deliver fast iterations based on performance feedback.
  • Maintain brand consistency while still pushing creative boundaries.
  • Collaborate with growth/marketing to align creative with testing strategy and learnings.


Minimum requirements (non-negotiable)


To be considered, you must meet the requirements below and include proof in your application:

  • Resume must be written in English.
  • You must share examples of your AI video ad work with VO and Dialogue (not just AI visuals).
  • Copywriting is required: you must provide evidence you wrote/owned the scripts and ad copy for at least some of the work you share (scripts, hook lists, on-screen text, captions, or a short case study describing your role).
  • You must provide at least ONE of the following:
  • Evidence you produced creatives that generated strong ROAS / conversion lift (screenshots, case study, or summary metrics), OR
  • A video you produced that achieved 10,000+ views , OR
  • Proof you can create complex AI short-form ad videos (not basic slideshow edits-think narrative, scene continuity, ad pacing, multiple AI shots, strong compositing).
  • You have managed or been part of a social media account with 10,000+ followers .


What “qualified” looks like (skills we’re actively looking for)


You don’t just edit-you communicate and convert.

  • You understand what makes a video ad perform: thumb-stopping hooks, clear messaging, pattern interrupts, pacing, proof, offer structure, CTA clarity .
  • You can write direct-response copy that sounds human, specific, and brand-right-not generic “AI marketing” language.
  • You can create AI-driven visuals that look intentional and brand-ready (not uncanny or generic).
  • You can edit like a performance creator: tight cuts, retention-first pacing, captions, kinetic typography, sound design.
  • You have a repeatable workflow to deliver high volume with high quality (and keep assets organized).


Tools & workflows (use what you’re best at)


We’re tool-agnostic, but you should be highly capable with several of the following:

AI + creative

  • AI video generation (e.g., Runway, Pika, or comparable tools)
  • AI image generation (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Voice & audio (AI voiceover tools, sound design, music selection, cleanup)

Editing + delivery

  • Editing & motion (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, etc.)
  • Creative versioning + organized file delivery (naming conventions, aspect ratios, exports)

Copywriting workflow (important)

  • You can work quickly in tools like Docs/Notion , and you know how to build:
  • Hook banks
  • Script variations
  • Angle matrices
  • Offer/CTA libraries
  • Caption + primary text variants aligned to the video


Deliverables & expectations


Typical output: 10 ad creatives per month (depending on campaign cycle), plus variations.

Format mastery: 9:16 primary , plus 1:1 and 16:9 cutdowns when needed.

You can deliver:

  • Final exports (platform-ready)
  • Project files when requested
  • Source assets used (AI outputs, overlays, audio references)

Copy deliverables (required):

  • Script + VO text (or structured script outline)
  • Hook variations (often 5-15 per concept)
  • On-screen text + caption plan (what appears when, and why)
  • End card copy + CTA variants
  • Optional: primary text/caption variants for Meta/TikTok where needed

Turnaround: fast iteration is key (often 24-72 hours per revision cycle , depending on scope).


How we evaluate success


  • Your creatives clearly map to an angle + message and drive action.
  • Iterations improve performance (hooks improve, retention improves, CTR/CVR improves).
  • Your output is consistent, organized, and easy to test at scale.
  • Your copy + editing work together (the words and visuals reinforce the same conversion story).

﻿

Compensation


Competitive and flexible based on experience and proof of performance.

Per project bases

If you’re a performance-minded AI creative who can write high-converting scripts and ship high-quality ads fast -and you have proof-apply with the items above.

title: Program Coordinator
description:
About Sofia Health

Sofia Health is a fast-growing wellness marketplace connecting clients with top health and wellness professionals. Through live classes, on-demand content, and 1:1 services, we’re making whole-person care more accessible and helping providers build thriving businesses.


Sofia Prime is our flagship wellness membership, offering 300+ live virtual classes every month focused on physical, mental, and emotional well-being—including yoga, meditation, fitness, tai chi, iRest, health coaching, and more.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Virtual Wellness Program Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of our Sofia Prime program. In this role, you’ll help with day-to-day operations, communicate with instructors, support clients, ensure a seamless experience for both sides of the platform, and help expand participation and engagement across the platform.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role ideal for someone passionate about wellness, tech-enabled solutions, and community building.


Responsibilities
  • Coordinate and publish weekly and monthly live class schedules
  • Communicate with wellness instructors to confirm availability, gather class details, and ensure timely updates
  • Provide basic support to clients and instructors (e.g., tech check-ins, live session support, FAQs)
  • Assist with monitoring class attendance and flagging any issues or trends
  • Help gather and organize feedback from members to improve class offerings
  • Collaborate with marketing and community teams to promote upcoming classes
  • Maintain accurate records and help ensure consistent program delivery


Requirements
  • 1–3 years of experience in wellness programming, admin coordination, virtual event management, or community support
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through
  • Comfortable using Zoom, Google Suite, and digital scheduling tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Enthusiastic, team-oriented, and passionate about wellness
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Bonus Points
  • Experience working at a health tech or wellness startup
  • Background in virtual wellness delivery or e-learning company
  • Familiarity with wellness programming tools and virtual event logistics

title: Analista BPO Contábil
description:
O Analista Contábil Pleno será responsável pela execução e suporte das rotinas contábeis em um ambiente de terceirização de processos (BPO), garantindo a precisão nas operações contábeis e aderência às normas e legislações vigentes. Atuará diretamente com diversos sistemas ERP, sendo responsável pela conciliação contábil, fechamentos mensais e apuração de resultados, além de prestar suporte em projetos de migração de sistemas e melhorias de processos. Esta oportunidade é voltada para Concessionárias de Veículos.


Fazendo parte do time você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Fazer parte de uma equipe vencedora e trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo;
  • Aprender e crescer profissionalmente com treinamentos e workshops;
  • Ter um impacto real na empresa, ajudando-a a alcançar seus objetivos;
  • Desfrutar de uma excelente remuneração e benefícios incríveis,
  • Conciliar sua vida pessoal e profissional com uma jornada de trabalho compatível, pois presamos pelo bem estar de nossos colaboradores.


DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:


Qualificações Necessárias:

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis (CRC ativo ou em andamento).
  • Conhecimento atualizado em normas contábeis (BRGAAP, IFRS).
  • Domínio em lançamentos contábeis, conciliações, fechamento de balanços e balancetes.
  • Experiência no uso de diferentes sistemas ERP para a execução de rotinas contábeis.
  • Conhecimento em obrigações acessórias relacionadas à contabilidade, como SPED Contábil e ECF.


Experiência Desejável:

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência na área contábil, preferencialmente em empresas de BPO ou consultorias.
  • Atuação com diversos sistemas de ERP (ex: TOTVS, SAP, Omie, Sankhya, Linx, Questor), garantindo adaptação a diferentes plataformas tecnológicas.
  • Vivência em processos de conciliação bancária, provisões, e controle de ativo imobilizado.
  • Experiência em projetos de migração de sistemas contábeis e integração de dados entre sistemas.


Obs: Conhecimento no sistema Linx, será um grande diferencial.

Autonomia:

  • Possuem maior autonomia para realizar suas tarefas e tomar decisões.
  • Podem supervisionar e orientar analistas Junior.


Principais atividades:

  • Conciliação contábil e bancária, assegurando que os lançamentos sejam devidamente registrados e conferidos em sistemas ERP diversos.
  • Fechamento contábil mensal e anual, garantindo a preparação e revisão de balanços, balancetes e demonstrações financeiras.
  • Análise de resultados e elaboração de relatórios contábeis, garantindo a correta apuração dos dados e aderência às normas contábeis.
  • Geração e entrega das obrigações acessórias contábeis, como SPED Contábil e ECF, em conformidade com os prazos e exigências legais.
  • Participação em projetos de migração e integração de sistemas ERP, realizando ajustes contábeis e adequando as rotinas de acordo com os novos sistemas implantados.
  • Suporte ao atendimento de auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo as informações contábeis necessárias para revisão e avaliação.
  • Gerenciar a equipe contábil, promovendo o desenvolvimento contínuo dos colaboradores, é responsável pela aplicação da Avaliação de Desempenho da equipe, elaboração de PDIs, controle de jornada de ponto, e reuniões de feedbacks com a equipe.


OFERECEMOS

  • ·       Salário compatível
  • ·       Vale alimentação/Refeição: para contribuir com sua alimentação;
  • ·        Auxílio Educação: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento profissional com um auxílio de até R$ 300,00 mensais (conforme política da empresa);
  • ·        Pesquisa de Clima: Pesquisa de clima e sugestões para garantir o bem-estar de nossos profissionais.
  • ·       PDI: Planeje seu desenvolvimento profissional e alcance seus objetivos de carreira com a ajuda da empresa;
  • ·       Premiação anual: Reconhecendo seu esforço e desempenho com premiação com base nos resultados da empresa (conforme política interna).


Então não perca tempo e envie seu currículo, agora mesmo!

title: Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas - SDR
description:
Descrição padrão da vaga (TOKZ-AGÊNCIA PARCEIRA OFICIAL DO TIKTOK SHOP) - Braço de serviço originado na Mybest (HUB DE LIVES Tiktok Shop)

Formato: PJ - home

Remuneração 3k fixo/mês + % sobre as vendas.


Somos um hub digital que opera exclusivamente TikTok Shop. Somos, dinâmicos e sempre em evolução, conectando tendências globais com um olhar estratégico para o futuro.


Como SDR, você será responsável por abrir portas: identificar, abordar e aquecer potenciais clientes com inteligência, empatia e estratégia.

Seu papel é essencial para manter nosso funil de vendas sempre cheio de boas oportunidades.


Prospecção ativa e qualificação de leads.


Negociação e fechamento de contratos.


Elaboração de propostas comerciais personalizadas, garantindo preços competitivos e condições vantajosas para os clientes.


Acompanhamento de pedidos e relacionamento com clientes, desde a negociação até a entrega dos produtos.

Trabalho estratégico com times de marketing e operações para desenvolver ações que aumentem a demanda e lista de leads.


Habilidades:


Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.


Perfil orientado para metas e resultados.


Sucesso na jornada.
